# Copilot Instructions — workteams-frontend

## Mandatory owner ChatGPT response timestamp footer — October 23, 2026

Read and follow the **mandatory ChatGPT date/time footer** rule in the repository root `AGENTS.md` on **every coding-agent reply, task update, audit, build/deployment summary and copy-paste handoff**.

End each response with these two independently accurate America/Chicago (CST/CDT) timestamps:

```
LAST WORKED: Month Day, Year — H:MM AM/PM CDT/CST
CURRENT UPDATE: Month Day, Year — H:MM AM/PM CDT/CST
```

LAST WORKED is per conversation and advances only after meaningful work in that conversation; CURRENT UPDATE is the response time. Never invent either exact timestamp, substitute another thread’s date, or mistake a GitHub commit time for conversation work time. If unavailable, say so. This instruction concerns **ChatGPT communication**, not public app screens.

All other application development, security, tenant, release and handoff rules in `AGENTS.md` remain mandatory.
